decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording module_pin_count as 40, so no addition or edit is required.
Clarifying that the physical module has 40 pins rather than the development board's 44 positions does not change any confirmed GPIO assignment.
The module pin-count clarification does not change the panel-control connector inventory, signals, or button-placement policy.
The clarified module pin count does not alter the BOOT or reset controls or their timing-network capacitances.
Mention of the ESP32-S3 as a powered load is incidental; its physical pin count does not change DCDC1 voltage, capacity, or load coverage.
The physical module pin-count clarification does not change standalone USB power behavior, regulator selection, or powered-rail coverage.
The source does not change the 5V boost enable GPIO, control behavior, routing, or powered loads.
The module's physical pin count does not change USB data routing, enumeration, flashing, or standalone-programming support.
The source does not alter I2C pin topology, pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, or bus speed.
The ESP32-S3 reference is only part of existing load coverage; the pin-count clarification does not change the battery or system power path.
The source concerns the ESP32 module and breakout count, not the sensor-board connector fanout or connector pinouts.
The module pin-count clarification does not change the LED data GPIO, supply voltage, power control, or level-shifting policy.
